objective: Seal the WP-024 blind-handoff experiment and re-anchor operational state on it, so the experiment is resumable under the one-Work-Package rule.
completed: Amended the preregistration to v2 before run 1; v1 stays in git history
Sealed model claude-opus-5 and reasoning configuration in the preregistration, not in the results file
Required all nine fixtures and oracles to exist before ANY run, closing an adaptive-construction hole
Replaced the single bundle_sha256 with a per-file manifest carrying byte counts, and granted one read-only sha256sum
Promoted fixture 8 (external API unavailable) to mandatory
Retired NS-001 (Pages enabled, serving 200) and NS-029 (all pull requests merged, zero open)
remaining: Author and seal nine fixtures and nine oracles - NS-030
Publish every result and failure verbatim
observations: An LLM cannot derive SHA-256 from file contents, so fixture 9 was unrunnable as first specified. The manifest is now per-file and a hashing tool is granted.
v1 permitted sealing fixture 2 after observing fixture 1, which is adaptive test construction with an aggregate score attached. v2 requires all nine before any run.

Sampling temperature, top-p and seed are not settable through this harness. They are recorded as uncontrolled rather than asserted as fixed; naming a parameter the harness cannot set would be a false control.
decisions: Amend rather than void: no run had executed and no fixture or results file existed, which is the only condition under which a preregistration may change.
Seal the model in the preregistration, not the results file, because deferring it permits post-result selection.
Promote fixture 8 to mandatory: the proposal's own invariant is UNKNOWN-not-a-guess, so passing while failing that condition would certify the opposite of the hypothesis.
assumptions: The harness can supply a trusted evaluation_time and per-file digests that the agent under test cannot influence

blockers.resolution: Author and commit nine fixtures and nine oracles before any run.

stop_if: A results file exists but the fixtures were sealed after it
Fewer than nine fixtures or nine oracles exist and a run is being requested
PRIMARY_NEXT_ACTION names a pull request that already reports state MERGED

declared_non_coverage: This checkpoint does not test whether a deriver can produce these bundles; fixtures are hand-authored
It proves nothing about the correctness of derivation, only about the consumer contract
27 runs is a discovery round and supports no reliability claim
This re-anchor is itself a hand-correction - the third in two days - and is the defect under test, not evidence for the proposal
